description:
Activate the artifact creature with Presence of Gond attached by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the artifact creature with Presence of Gond attached.
Repeat.

uses.name: Presence of Gond
uses.cardState: attached to an artifact creature you control that does not have summoning sickness
